text:
The evidence can't say why the loss happened. The tools show that tree cover was lost, not the cause (clearing, harvest, fire, etc.), and the one dataset that might have helped, MGAP 2021, was unavailable.

What the data does show:
- Hansen GFC records a 25.5 ha tree-cover loss event in 2015. It falls before the 2020-12-31 baseline, so it is treated as history, not a new event.
- Other earlier losses were 0.8 ha (2008), 4.8 ha (2017) and 67.7 ha (2020).
- JRC GFC2020 shows no forest on the property in 2020,
